senses.gloss: f. (ואל, cmp. b. h. יָעַל a. הוֹאִיל) propriety. לא ו׳ it is unbecoming.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 8b">Ned. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ו׳ למישׁרא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="U01959"><he>שרי</he></cite>, Var. <he>יאי</he>; Naḥm. <he>יאלי</he>) it is unbecoming (for a pupil) to absolve from a vow in a place where his teacher lives. Contr. <cite ref="F00059"><he>וָלָא</he></cite>.
